blocks.content: The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) is one of the most important Constitutional Bodies in India. It is responsible for recruiting candidates for All India Services and Central Civil Services.
The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) is one of the most important Constitutional Bodies in India.

items: UPSC is explicitly a Constitutional Body, not a statutory or executive body.
UPSC handles recruitment for both All India Services and Central Civil Services.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) is a major Constitutional Body in India.
It carries the mandate of recruiting candidates for All India Services.
It is responsible for recruitment into various Central Civil Services.
